We do not apply normalization to the output tokens unless it is specifically done by the evaluation framework. We evaluate 15 foundation models using their publicly available weights: UNI2-H [ 13 ] , H-Optimus-0 [ 67 ] , Midnight-12k [ 38 ] , Virchow2 [ 82 ] , Prov-GigaPath [ 79 ] , UNI [ 13 ] , Phikon-v2 [ 25 ] , the ViT-B/8, ViT-B/16, ViT-S/8, and ViT-S/16 from [ 1 ] , Hibou-B [ 56 ] , Phikon [ 24 ] , and the ViT-S/8, and ViT-S/16 from [ 37 ] . For five additional models, Pluto-4G [ 60 ] , Pluto-4S-8 [ 60 ] , Pluto-4S-16 [ 60 ] , H-Optimus-1 [ 9 ] , and H0-mini [ 22 ] we include comparisons based on published results, as model weights are either not publicly released or not accessible to us for evaluation. The HEST-Benchmark [ 34 ] is composed of tasks for gene expression prediction and designed as multivariate regression. We use the default evaluation protocol and implementation [ 30 ] . The protocol leverages a Ridge Regression with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to solve the multivariate regression on the extracted foundation model embeddings.
